_comment: Stage 4 Part 2 — externalized applicability/selection table for DM 1975 + Salva Casa. classify()/check_space() in checker.py read this at runtime. Generated from checker.py's frozen hint tuples; a load-time guard pins it set-equal to them incl. codepoints. 'unknown' is the STRICT COMPLEMENT of accessory∪habitable and is intentionally NOT stored. provenance/statute_anchor are CARRIED for Part 3 (gate anchoring) but NOT verified here.

accessory._note: lower 2.40 m height bar; aero 1/8 N/A (separate ventilation rules).

hint_groups._note: accessory rooms literally enumerated in DM-1975 Art.1 (dm_1975_salva_casa.md:9-10) — the only gate-anchorable accessory tokens (Part 3). gabinetti is carried via synonyms wc/toilet below.

English + non-enumerated Italian (ingresso/lavanderia) + German/KIT (Stage 3) accessory synonyms — NO Italian-statute anchor; declared named debt (baseline §7), test-pinned, not over-claimed as verified.

habitable._note: 2.70 m height bar; aero 1/8 applies. Salva-Casa swaps the bar to 2.40 m.

hint_groups._note: Art.1 does NOT enumerate habitable room types (habitable is the complement, 'locali adibiti ad abitazione'); every habitable hint is an unanchored heuristic = named debt (baseline §7).

salva_casa_regime._note: Comma 5-ter is a cumulative-AND SCENARIO (recupero/cambio d'uso + adattabilità DM 236/1989 + concurrent ristrutturazione), not a per-field flag. Modelled here as the height swap it produces for non-accessory rooms; the AND-conditions are Part 4/gate scope.
